title: Add optional stage-2 llama.cpp reranking (Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B) after RRF fusion in codesearch

sections.what: Add an optional stage-2 cross-encoder reranker step to codesearch after hybrid BM25+vector RRF fusion, targeting a local llama.cpp server running Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B GGUF from E:.
sections.why: Hybrid BM25+vector RRF promotes false positives that merely share keywords (such as unrelated scenes sharing a word like 'scared'). A local Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B cross-encoder scores (instruction + query, chunk) pairs together to promote true causal matches without cloud API costs.
sections.how:
1. Add rerank configuration in src/codesearch/config.py (RERANK_ENABLED, RERANK_ENDPOINT, RERANK_MODEL, RERANK_TOP_K, RERANK_TIMEOUT, RERANK_INSTRUCTION) and optional llama-server rerank launch support alongside existing embed-server (--rerank / GGUF path on E:).
2. Add a lightweight rerank_results(query, candidates, ...) client in a new src/codesearch/reranker.py (or in embedder/search) supporting llama.cpp /v1/rerank (and /rerank) with Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B instruction formatting.
3. Wire stage-2 reranking into Searcher.search() after RRF fusion over the top-N candidates (e.g. top 24-30 -> reranked top `limit`), preserving strict=true and metadata filters.
4. Fall back cleanly to RRF ordering with diagnostic timing/error reporting when the rerank server is offline or times out, and add unit tests with mocked HTTP responses plus offline fallback.
sections.verify: Run pytest in F:\AI\codesearch covering mocked /v1/rerank reordering, instruction pass-through, and offline timeout fallback, plus live test against llama-server on E: with Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B GGUF.

acceptance.text: Optional stage-2 reranking integrates cleanly after RRF fusion in Searcher.search() and search_code() without blocking when the reranker server is offline.
Supports llama.cpp / OpenAI-compatible /v1/rerank (or /rerank) with Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B GGUF hosted from E: drive via configurable endpoint, model, top_k, and optional instruction.
Gracefully falls back to raw RRF order (recording timing/warning diagnostics) on timeout or connection error, with pytest coverage.

evidence: Added RERANK_* config options in src/codesearch/config.py and qwen3-reranker-0.6b (--reranking) preset in src/codesearch/embed_server.py.
Added src/codesearch/reranker.py with Qwen3 instruction formatting, /v1/rerank + /rerank client, and clean offline/timeout fallback.
Wired stage-2 reranking into Searcher.search() (src/codesearch/search.py) and search_code() (src/codesearch/mcp_server.py).
Verified with `pytest -k rerank` (1 passed: mocked /v1/rerank reordering, offline fallback, and --reranking command check).
